```sql
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.match_id) AS matches_won_by_batting_first
FROM matches m
JOIN (
    SELECT match_id, batting_team
    FROM deliveries
    WHERE inning = 1
    GROUP BY match_id, batting_team
) d ON m.match_id = d.match_id
WHERE m.season = 2019
  AND m.winner = d.batting_team;
```
